scores.note: Option 3 'the distinction ... becomes indistinguishable' is tautological and garbled: 0. Options 1 and 4 ('cannot distinguish', 'can no longer differentiate') are good formal upgrades. Option 2 is only a mild change. Option 5 'fail to distinguish' implies an attempt and 'By the conclusion' is slightly stiff. Options share the same frame, limiting variety.
